# Draft:Restaurantware

----
Restaurantware is an online, Illinois-based  distributor of kitchenware for restaurants, supplying businesses with over 10,000 articles listed on their website.
Restaurantware, or RBG, operates under the name trademarked as U.S. Patent Number 5293708, which grants the company permission to carry out business and represent their products using that name.
Much of the company's business is done via Amazon, shipping utensils and kitchenware around the world.
